principles.name: Ethical and Effective Leadership
principles.question: Does the board lead ethically and effectively?
principles.description: Achieve an ethical culture and performance.

principles.name: Ethics and Corporate Citizenship
principles.question: Is the 'Botho' philosophy integrated into corporate citizenship?
principles.description: Organization as a responsible corporate citizen.

principles.name: Strategy, Performance and Reporting
principles.question: Is value creation measured across all six capitals?

principles.name: Reporting
principles.question: Does the report use the King V Mandatory Disclosure Template?

principles.name: Governing Body Composition
principles.question: Is the board majority independent with a 9-year tenure cap?

principles.name: Committees of the Governing Body
principles.question: Are the Audit and Risk committees properly independent?

principles.name: Risk and Compliance Governance
principles.question: Is risk oversight integrated into strategic opportunities?
principles.description: Govern risk and compliance to support strategic objectives.

principles.name: Information and Technology (including AI)
principles.question: Is there human accountability for AI-driven decisions?
principles.description: Ethical use of AI, data sovereignty, and security.

principles.name: Compliance Governance
principles.question: Is there a framework for the Botswana Data Protection Act?

principles.name: Delegation to Management
principles.question: Is there a formal, annual review of management authority?

principles.name: Remuneration Governance
principles.question: Is pay linked to social and environmental outcomes?

principles.name: Stakeholder Relationships
principles.question: Is the stakeholder approach truly inclusive?
